tools.name: scry_connect
tools.description: Get everything needed to connect an AI agent or MCP client to Scry, the SQL research surface over the public internet (Reddit, Hacker News, arXiv, Stack Exchange, Wikipedia, prediction markets, social archives). Returns the MCP server URL, setup commands for Claude Code / Codex / ChatGPT / Cursor, the HTTP API contract, and the signup link. Call this instead of scraping the page.

tools.name: scry_feedback
tools.description: Send feedback, a question, or a data-source / parser-contribution request to the Scry team on behalf of your user. Include contact details in the message if a reply is wanted.

message.description: The feedback or request, plain text. Include an email or handle if the user wants a reply.
